randint

questions.starter: # Two ends in. Smallest total, biggest total, how many totals.
require: randint
Both dice have to be rolled with random.randint. The three numbers you display are facts about what those two rolls could come to.

tests.why: Two ordinary dice total from 2 to 12, which is eleven different totals.
A dice that always shows 2 gives one total only, and that total is 4.
20 totals means the counting forgot that both ends are possible.

questions.q: This program should display the total and then the average to 1 decimal place. Find the mistake and put it right.

walk: The total line is already right.
Look at what round() has been given on the second line.
With nothing else to go on, round() goes to a whole number.

questions.starter:
a = int(input())
b = int(input())
c = int(input())
total = a + b + c
print(total)
print(round(total / 3))

tests.why: 6 on the second line means round() was left to go to a whole number.

questions.starter: # One whole number in. Its cube, then that cube in hundreds and what is left.

tests.why: 15 on the first line means the number was multiplied by 3. The power 3 is three of them multiplied together.
